A duct larger than its bore consumes the remaining space. This is not a fit approval.

Total

150 DPC band + 100 clear duct already consumes 250.
150 / 225 voids fail THIS straight below-band route.
300 - 150 - 100 = 50 for body and all other spacing.
Drawn 20 + 30 gaps spend that 50: no body margin.
An offset or different DPC/vent arrangement is a new
section, not permission to perforate the mineral DPC.
No U-value, bearing, weather seal, ventilation layout
or membrane-omission decision is established.
C Conditions travel together
GROUND No sunken wet pit or pump dependency. Gas, heave and flood evidence remain site-specific.
WALL Mineral DPC must interrupt the actual support path; protect floor ends from lateral cavity water.
FLOOR Qualify the complete mineral structure, thermal edge, air closure and all retained constituents.
SERVICES Keep routine pipe renewal accessible; do not cut structural beams or count this void as a crawlway.
Decision: retain a suspended-floor alternative; do not delete the DPM from the existing slab arrangement.
Source and limits: ../suspended-mineral-ground-floor.md | No geometry, material exception or packet completion is adopted.
